tool.name: OGS: createMeshElemPropertiesFromASCRaster
tool.description: Generates properties for mesh elements of an input mesh deploying a ASC raster file.
tool.command: ln -sf '$raster_file' 'raster_file.asc'; ln -sf '$mesh' 'mesh.vtu'; createMeshElemPropertiesFromASCRaster $output_refined_raster #if str($refine) --refine '$refine' #end if --raster-file 'raster_file.asc' --property-name '$property_name' --mesh 'mesh.vtu' --out-mesh output_1.vtu

param.label: output refined raster
param.help: Write refined raster to an additional, new ASC file.

param.label: refine
param.help: refinement factor that raises the resolution of the raster data

param.label: raster file
param.help: Input (.asc). The name of the input ASC raster file

param.label: property name
param.help: the name of the property the values are stored for

validator.message: only letters, digits, spaces and the characters = - _ . ( ) / + * ^ , : ? ! are allowed

param.label: mesh
param.help: Input (.vtu). The input mesh is read from this file

tool.help: Generates properties for mesh elements of an input mesh deploying a ASC raster file.
